about: Is the collage look ready to sell? Nine prompts across subjects and audiences, made in collage and in the look it competes with (painted, which also paints its pictures with a model), and three of them hand-drawn too. Read against the bar: professional for its audience, fits the subject, childish only where it should be, and not a newspaper where a newspaper is wrong (the one collage example is a newspaper, so watch for every film becoming one). icecream is the Runway post's own prompt (2026-09-28), borshch is in Ukrainian (the print faces' Cyrillic), suez is two minutes long. Built 2026-09-29 for the collage look (studio/looks/collage.md).

prompts.audience: adults: a portfolio piece for social video
prompts.prompt: Create a 60 second motion graphic explainer video about the history of ice cream from the inception, to present day. The art style should be newspaper cutout / mixed media aesthetic with a high degree of polish. This piece is for your portfolio, so make sure to make it great.

prompts.audience: adults: a sombre piece of history
prompts.prompt: The evacuation of Pripyat on 27 April 1986, the day after the accident at the Chernobyl nuclear plant.
What happens in the first hour after someone arrives at hospital with a stroke, explained for the family waiting outside.
A launch video for Ledgerly, an expense app: snap a photo of a receipt, and it is read, filed, approved and paid back within a day.
A promo for a street-food festival in Lisbon: three nights, forty stalls and live music by the river.
Why volcanoes erupt, explained for a class of 10 to 12 year olds.
A bedtime story for a four-year-old: a paper boat sails across the bath to find the rubber duck.
Коротке пояснювальне відео українською: звідки взявся борщ, як він став символом України і що в ньому головне.

prompts.audience: adults: curious viewers, a news explainer
prompts.prompt: Why one ship stuck in the Suez Canal in March 2021 held up about ten billion dollars of trade a day: the canal, the ship, the six days, and what it showed about world trade.
